description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named SearchViewActionBar that demonstrates how to integrate a SearchView into the ActionBar as a menu item, handle search queries, and set up suggestions.

classes.name: SearchViewActionBar
classes.description: An Activity class demonstrating the use of SearchView within the ActionBar for search functionalities, including suggestions and query handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout, and references the status TextView.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu, retrieves the SearchView from the menu, and calls setupSearchView.

methods.name: setupSearchView
methods.description: Configures the SearchView with searchable info, expansion behavior, and query text listener.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Handles real-time changes in the search query, updates the status view.

methods.name: onQueryTextSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of search queries, updates the status view.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Handles closing of the SearchView, updates the status view.

methods.name: isAlwaysExpanded
methods.description: Determines if the SearchView should be always expanded; default is false.
